observations.why: The deontic 'must' enacts a directive stance — the pipeline is obligated to produce a slug, a command structure ranking the speaker's requirement above the system's discretion.

mints.name: PipelineMustDirective
mints.title: the pipeline must produce a slug and commit the file successfully
mints.frame: Is the speaker enacting a command over a system's behavior, prescribing what it must do rather than describing what it does?
